$description: Calque-translation dictionary for the Arabic AI-Text Humanizer. Each entry maps an English term to: (a) the AI-default calque that naive translators produce, (b) the natural Arabic form that native tech/news writers use. v2.4.0 expansion adds process/workflow, agents/swarm/multi-agent, expanded database, DevOps, crypto/Web3, healthcare, climate, and geopolitics.
$curation_notes: Excluded entries with semantic sense errors or risky calque-keys that have legitimate non-calque meanings: ['demonstration', 'equity', 'logging', 'policy'].

entries.disambiguation_warning: جمع التبرعات = charity donations (NGO sense). For startup/VC fundraising use جمع التمويل or جولة تمويل. Original entry conflated both.
entries.v2_6_triage_note: Original mapping to جمع التبرعات was wrong-sense (charity, not VC). Native MSA business writing uses جمع التمويل.

claude.natural: الحد الأدنى من المنتج القابل للتطبيق

entries.v2_6_triage_note: رأس المال المغامر was a single-LLM-vote calque. Corpus-attested MSA: رأس المال المخاطر or رأس المال الاستثماري (UN/IMF Arabic).

entries.disambiguation_warning: الاحترار العالمي = global warming (temperature trend). الاحتباس الحراري = greenhouse effect (the mechanism). UN/IPCC Arabic keeps these distinct; do NOT collapse.
entries.v2_6_triage_note: Original collapsed both to الاحتباس الحراري, destroying a real climate-science distinction. Keep them separate per UN/IPCC.

entries.disambiguation_warning: نازح = internally displaced person (IDP). Distinct from لاجئ (cross-border refugee). Do NOT swap in Gaza / Sudan / Syria reporting.
entries.v2_6_triage_note: Pair-partner of refugee entry; see disambiguation_pair_id.
Sign-flip bug — Claude's LLM-vote marked الأخبار الكاذبة as the calque when it's actually the corpus-attested natural form (Aljazeera/BBC Arabic).

entries.disambiguation_warning: حركة شعبية has Hamas/PFLP resonance in Levant/Egypt; pan-Arab MSA neutral is حركة قاعدية.
entries.v2_6_triage_note: حركة شعبية carries Islamist-populist political coloring in non-Gulf usage. حركة قاعدية is the neutral pan-Arab MSA option.

entries.disambiguation_warning: لاجئ = 1951 Convention refugee (cross-border). Distinct from نازح (IDP, internal). Do NOT swap in Gaza / Sudan / Syria reporting.
entries.v2_6_triage_note: Legal distinction matters; flagging pairs prevents downstream LLM cognitive pass from swapping them.

entries.user_note: Per native-speaker correction: AI translators sometimes render 'approach' / 'method' / 'manner' as سلوكاً (mansoob behavior-sense). Conservative: only the mansoob form (سلوكا, post-tashkeel) is matched to avoid false positives on legitimate behavior-sense uses of bare سلوك in psychology/zoology contexts. News/opinion register only.

entries.user_correction_v2.4.5: Per native-speaker review: ذكاء الأسراب (biological swarms) replaced with مجموعة (group) — neutral technical term.

entries.user_note: Per native-speaker correction: AI translators sometimes use the plural form ذكاء الأسراب for 'swarm intelligence' — biologically accurate (swarms of birds/insects) but a calque in CS context. Modern Arabic CS literature prefers ذكاء المجموعة (group intelligence) or الذكاء الجماعي (collective intelligence).

entries.disambiguation_warning: In Saudi context, التخصيص is the official term for the privatization program (Vision 2030). Use الشخصنة for software UX personalization.
entries.v2_6_triage_note: v2.4.0 had the direction REVERSED. Agent A: الشخصنة is the modern attested term in Wamda/AlJazeera Net post-2015; التخصيص in Saudi context = privatization (برنامج التخصيص).
